first_duel_play.why: In SUGSEG's first polygon battle (its music, SsSeqPlay at vsync 19598), two notes of vsync 19620 get voices 2 and 3 in the emulator, 1 and 2 in the replay: a one-shot note on voice 1, keyed on at the flush of 19616, reaches its sample's end 1 sample before the flush of 19620 in our SPU core (End+Mute: its envelope reads 0, so LIBSND's allocator takes it) and after it in PCSX-Redux. A one-sample margin of the SPU's position against the CPU within a vsync (the replay renders the samples between two ticks from the emulator's CPU cycle counts, 768 a sample, but where the emulator's SPU stands when the flush's KON lands is its own); not LIBSND or the game. Everything before it is exact: the boot, the registration, SAISEG, the duel's first round into SUGSEG (183,089 stores and DMA blocks)
